asset_set: Questionnaire Q17 option 1 — Helping refugees settle locally

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single soft cel shadow ellipse under hands only — kept light, never heavy or ominous
art_style.texture: none on skin; faint woven-basket texture via 3 curved lines max
art_style.mood: gentle hopeful welcome energy — warm community kindness, never crisis or hardship
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
refugee camp, tents, or border fence imagery
crowds, protest signs, or distress body language

secondary.name: teal
secondary.use: small leaf-sprout accent on potted plant

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops and key surface
color.accent_rule: lavender appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: soft warm highlight on basket weave and key surface
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 10% opacity under hands only — soft, never heavy

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: offers a woven welcome basket forward
left_hand.grip: full palm under the basket handle
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: extends a house key resting on an open palm
right_hand.grip: flat open palm, key resting on its ribbon

pose.gesture_summary: welcoming freeze frame — the moment a key and basket are offered forward
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: looped once at wrist only — no badge text visible

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands offers a woven welcome basket of bread and fruit forward while the other extends a house key resting on a lavender ribbon across an open palm — a doorstep-warm gesture of welcome and new beginnings. The scene stays entirely symbolic and hopeful: no camps, no distress, no border imagery, just an open door and a gift of belonging.

primary_objects.name: welcome basket
primary_objects.detail: holds a round loaf of bread and two pieces of fruit, checkered cloth liner

primary_objects.name: house key
primary_objects.detail: simple bow-and-shaft shape, threaded on a lavender ribbon

primary_objects.name: ribbon
primary_objects.detail: looped once through the key bow

primary_objects.name: potted plant
primary_objects.material: terracotta pot with a small green sprout
primary_objects.detail: single simple sprout, a quiet symbol of new growth

subject.environment: warm doorstep threshold strip across bottom third — sunlit welcome-mat suggestion only, fades to transparent, no building facade or crowd
subject.sensitive_handling: Depict only a hopeful, symbolic welcome gesture — house key, bread, and a home doorstep. Do not depict refugee camps, border fences, distress, crowds, sadness, or any hardship imagery. Tone must read as warm community welcome, not crisis.

composition.layout: centered symmetrical offering — basket on the left, key on the right, both reaching toward the viewer
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 40px safe zone for card crop
composition.thumbnail_readability: basket silhouette + offered key readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter S, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, refugee camp, tents, border fence, crowd of people, distress, crying, sadness, war imagery, weapons, blood, protest signs
